Definition: of uncertain derivation; a military cloak:--robe.
BiblicalUsage: Chlamys is a military cloak, a robe, and the Gospels use it only for the robe put on Jesus in His suffering. The soldiers strip Him and put on Him a scarlet robe, and then they take the robe off Him again and lead Him away to be crucified.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the scarlet robe is mockery dressed as majesty, and Christ wore their scorn so that I could wear His righteousness.
